title: The SiMPL Method for Multi-Material Topology Optimization
summary: We introduce an efficient and scalable method for density-based multi-material topology optimization, integrating classical mirror descent techniques with point-wise polytopal design constraints. Such constraints arise naturally in this class of problems, wherein the vertices of convex polytopes correspond to distinct design states, only one of which should be occupied at each point in space.
